violation_type.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Regular Meals and Snacks (26 TAC §746.2419(4))
violation_type.short_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Regular Meals and Snacks
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed in part of a report and found to be deficient. An infant was not fed the regular meals provided by the parent.

finding_variants.text: This standard was reviewed in part of a report and found to be deficient. An infant was not fed the regular meals provided by the parent.

Based on the evidence obtained throughout the investigation, it was established that a child went without eating from 9:30am until she was pick up from the operation at approximately 4:00pm. Daily report documentation, statements, and video footage only verifies that attempts were made to feed the child milk only although the operation had written approval from the parent to provide table food and those attempts were unsuccessful.
Based on evidence obtained dung the investigation, two children were not fed according to their normal mealtimes.
